The '''Near Vacuum Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that operated on [[Tolea Biqua]] on [[Genarius]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It had a [[Human/Legends|human]] bartender and the waitresses, including a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] one, wore "spacesuit" costumes with transparent arms and legs. It was clean and the drinks were relatively cheap. It had a large fishtank inside it, that ran from the floor to the ceiling and contained amphibians.

The [[Heroes of Cularin]] once went there in search of [[Berpo]], a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] criminal who was drinking there, with a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and a female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. Berpo felt threatened by the heroes, so he put a [[Vibrodagger/Legends|vibrodagger]] to the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek's]] throat and threatened to kill her if they came close to him.
